name: Bank 5
description: Bank 5: a fintech-style redesign of the full Manya Krobo Rural Bank website (same content and 95 pages as the manya-krobo template). Floating glass pill navigation with a sliding hover indicator and animated mega panels, a dark mesh-gradient hero with live product mockups and parallax, partner marquee, bento grid with count-up figures, an inline salary-loan calculator, a U-Connect phone mockup, a draggable community-story scroller and a giant-wordmark footer. Motion: split-word heading reveals, scroll reveals, magnetic buttons, cursor spotlight on cards, hide-on-scroll header and a scroll progress bar, all switched off for reduced-motion visitors. Bank facts live in _build/bank.mjs; run node templates/bank-5/_build/gen.mjs to regenerate pages. ?review=1 highlights figures still to confirm.
